prompt_text: What is the best Airbnb or short term rental to book in Nashville for a family of four?
answer_verbatim:
For a family of four, I’d start with a **well-reviewed two-bedroom, two-bath condo in SoBro or downtown**. You’ll be close to Broadway and major attractions, while a kitchen and separate bedrooms make family stays easier. One promising option in the listings is **“Nash 2BR 2BA—Private Balcony—Free Parking—Pool”**: it’s listed with a 4.98/5 rating from 242 reviews, a balcony, pool, and free parking. [View Nashville Airbnb listings](https://www.airbnb.com/nashville-tn/stays)

If you’d rather have a quieter, more residential feel, look in **East Nashville**; it’s still a short drive from downtown and often offers more space. [Browse family-friendly Nashville rentals](https://www.airbnb.com/nashville-tn/stays/family-friendly)

I can’t confirm availability or total price without your dates. Before booking, check that the listing has **two actual bedrooms**, recent reviews, clear cancellation terms, and parking details—especially if you’ll have a car. Share your dates, budget per night, and whether you prefer walkability or a quieter neighborhood, and I can narrow down the best fit.
